# GitHub Copilot / other coding agents

Canonical rules: `AGENTS.md`, plus `design-factory/AGENTS.md` for any frontend/UI/UX task.
Study current product and existing visual design first; use our design tokens, one selected UI kit, and accessible, bilingual components. Mandatory design evidence: actual browser captures at mobile/tablet/desktop with RTL/LTR and both themes, plus functioning controls. No invented screenshot review, no protected vendor asset duplication, no production auth bypass. See `design-factory/UPSTREAMS.md` for pinned sources and licence restrictions.

## Creative motion/icons/layers/video
For motion, creative iconography, layered landing pages, WebGL or code-driven video, follow `design-factory/CREATIVE_AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md`, `design-factory/CREATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `design-factory/creative-sources.lock.json` and `design-factory/creative-recipes/`. Prefer original offline `creative-effects.css` and `creative-primitives.js`, test reduced motion, fallback, licences and real browser frames. Video export goes through the owner's existing Animation Studio; never imply references are production dependencies.
